diagnostics.message: signature scheme 'bare' verifies by template and has no 'key'
diagnostics.fix: Name the key id the secret lookup receives: 'key: { value: <id> }' or 'key: { from: <path, query or header source> }'.

diagnostics.message: signature scheme 'bare' verifies by template and has no 'format', 'algorithm', 'payload', 'encoding'
diagnostics.fix: Declare format, algorithm, payload and encoding (ADR 0013), or set 'verify: application' to verify in the authenticate hook.

diagnostics.message: signature scheme 'listed' verifies by template and lists 'headers'
diagnostics.fix: Remove 'headers', which only 'verify: application' hands to the authenticate hook, or set 'verify: application'.
